UNSTABLEHEXTEST-UNSTABLE_HEX.title: Unstable Hex
UNSTABLEHEXTEST-UNSTABLE_HEX.description: Apply [blue]2[/blue] different random debuffs to an enemy. Possible results: [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold], [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold], or [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Debilitate[/gold].
